：天命。““操啊！”青州城，叶家议事厅内，二长老叶敖拍桌而起，双目似喷出火来，“八百？按照周边拆迁价格，我叶家祖祠至少值五万枚灵晶，而仙宝阁却只愿给八百？八百能做什么？老子去洗脚都只能洗脚而不能洗头。”另一名长老也怒道：“是他妈的赵家在搞事情，那赵修是这次拆迁的主事，谁不知我们叶家与他们赵家是世仇？他们是在故意针对我们，想刨我们叶家祖坟。”二长老神情变得有些狰狞，“他们不仅是想刨我们叶家祖坟，还想在我们叶家头上拉屎，而且是想拉泡稀的。”议事厅内，一众长老皆是满脸怒容，这仙宝阁与赵家实在是欺人太甚，不仅想杀人，还想诛心。为首的族长叶林脸上透着一股决绝，“只能走那条路了。”其余众人相视了一眼，皆是点头表示赞同，面对仙宝阁与赵家如此行径，叶家现在还有一条路可以走，那就是闹，把事情闹大，让更多的人与上面的人关注到，关注的人越多，舆论越大，事情就越有机会得到解决，当然，这是有风险的。有长老突然问，“让谁去？”一名长老道：“反正不能让叶南去，他下个月就要与李家丫头成婚。叶南，正是叶林的儿子，也是如今叶家的世子，是叶家百年来最为妖孽的人。叶林看了一眼那说话的长老，“那让谁去？”那长老犹豫了下，道：“让天命去？”叶天命，叶家在马路边捡来的养子，十年前有个算命的路过叶家，曾给其算命，言其有大帝之姿，不过，算命的人算完后当场就瞎了，这让叶天命在很长一段时间成为了青州城的笑柄。“我去！”门口突然传来一道声音。众人闻声看去，一名男子走了进来，男子十七岁左右，仪表堂堂，气度从容。来人正是世子叶南。叶南看着叶林等人，微微一礼，“爹，二叔，还有诸位族叔，我不仅是叶家世子，也是天命与叶宗他们的大哥，叶家有难，自然是我这个做世子与做大哥的，慢慢放出来哈。

> Chapter 1 Destiny (Page 1)
: Destiny. "Fuck!" "In Qingzhou City, in the Ye family meeting hall, the second elder Ye Ao stood up by slamming the table, his eyes seemed to be spitting out fire, "Eight hundred? According to the surrounding demolition prices, my Ye family ancestral temple is worth at least 50,000 spiritual crystals, but Xianbao Pavilion is only willing to give 800? What can eight hundred do? When I go to wash my feet, I can only wash my feet but not my hair. Another elder also said angrily: "It's the damn Zhao family who is causing trouble. Then Zhao Xiu is the person in charge of this demolition. Who doesn't know that our Ye family and their Zhao family are feuding?" They are deliberately targeting us and want to dig up the ancestral graves of our Ye family. The second elder's expression became a little ferocious, "They not only want to dig up the ancestral graves of our Ye family, but also want to poop on our Ye family's heads, and they want to poop on them." "In the meeting hall, all the elders had angry faces. The Xianbao Pavilion and the Zhao family really bullied people too much. They not only wanted to kill people, but also wanted to kill people. The leader of the clan, Ye Lin, had a look of determination on his face, "We can only go that way. "The rest of the people looked at each other and nodded in agreement. Faced with the behavior of Xianbao Pavilion and the Zhao family, the Ye family still has one way to go, and that is to make a fuss and make the matter bigger, so that more people and the people above will pay attention. The more people who pay attention, the greater the public opinion, the better the chance of the matter being resolved. Of course, this is risky. An elder suddenly asked, "Who should be allowed to go? "An elder said: "We can't let Ye Nan go anyway. He will marry the girl of the Li family next month. Ye Nan is Ye Lin's son and now the eldest son of the Ye family. He is the most evil person in the Ye family for a hundred years. Ye Lin glanced at the elder who spoke, "Then who should go?" The elder hesitated and said, "Let Tianming go?" Ye Tianming, the adopted son picked up by the Ye family on the roadside, ten years ago, a fortune teller passed by the Ye family and told his fortune, saying that he had the appearance of an emperor. However, the fortune teller went blind on the spot after finishing the calculation, which made Ye Tianming the laughing stock of Qingzhou City for a long time. "I'm going!" A voice suddenly came from the door. Everyone heard the sound and looked around, and a man walked in. The man was about seventeen years old, with a dignified appearance and a calm demeanor. The person who came was none other than the Crown Prince Ye Nan. Ye Nan looked at Ye Lin and others and gave a slight salute, "Father, second uncle, and other clan uncles, I am not only the eldest son of the Ye family, but also the eldest brother of Tianming and Ye Zong. If the Ye family is in trouble, naturally I, the eldest son and the eldest brother, will be the one to be released slowly.
